acceptanceCriteria: One internal package owns go test argv, environment, timeout and process-group handling; the four call sites use it, with focused tests proving unchanged argv per caller.
Each caller's existing tests pass unchanged; any intentional argv difference is recorded in the owning spec.
body: Read-only audit (docs/build-log/2026-10-17-binary-boundary-audit.md) found four packages that each build and run `go test` with no shared code: internal/sessiontest/run.go:128 (core `corvint test`), internal/liveverify/gorunner/runner.go:346, internal/liveverify/mutate/gotest.go:166 (prove --mutate) and internal/testrunner/native/native.go (TRE-V0). Flag handling, timeouts, environment and process-group cleanup can drift between them. Related precedent: V1-1235 (consolidate the Playwright JSON report parsers). This is the code-level half of the corvint-test consolidation and can land first.
title: Four independent `go test` command builders: consolidate into one internal runner package
